title: Parcel Delivery Tracker and Delays
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=delivery:parcel status!=delivered
| eval days_in_transit=round((now()-shipped_epoch)/86400,1), stuck=if(days_in_transit>7,1,0)
| sort - days_in_transit
| table carrier item days_in_transit status stuck
description: Tracks your in-flight parcels in one place and flags the ones stuck in transit far too long.
value: A single view of every incoming parcel replaces a dozen carrier apps and catches a lost package early.
implementation: Ingest tracking updates into `index=personal`; alert on parcels stuck in transit.
visualization: Table of in-transit parcels with days elapsed and stuck flag.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks all your incoming parcels in one place and flags any stuck in the post too long.
